facts.text: Onderon was a jungle world located within the Inner Rim.

evidence.quote: Onderon was a jungle world located within the Inner Rim.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, the planetary government seceded to the Confederacy of Independent Systems; in the Separatist Senate, Onderon was represented by Senator Mina Bonteri and later by her son, Lux Bonteri.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, the planetary government seceded to the Confederacy of Independent Systems; in the Separatist Senate, Onderon was represented by Senator Mina Bonteri and later by her son, Lux Bonteri.

evidence.quote: This band of rebels excised the Separatist occupation from the planet, opening the door to joining the Galactic Republic.

evidence.quote: When Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine transformed the Republic into the Galactic Empire and declared himself Emperor, the planet was taken over by the Imperials.

facts.text: Onderon was a temperate jungle planet.

evidence.quote: Onderon was a temperate jungle planet.

evidence.quote: In its earliest ages of civilization, Onderon was a world marked with savage jungles that were filled with dangerous creatures.

evidence.quote: Over time, these settlements grew to become enormous walled cities, including the planet's capital, Iziz.
